description.subtitle: Real Madrid adidas sports backpack (48 x 31 cm) - white
description.tagline: Bring the white spirit with you
description.intro: Real Madrid’s adidas backpack combines functionality, comfort and the unmistakable identity of Real Madrid in a design inspired by the club’s historic equipment. Designed to accompany you in the day to day, it offers the space needed to transport your belongings comfortably.
key_benefits: Gran capacidad: Espacio amplio para llevar ropa, material deportivo y accesorios.
Padded design: Greater comfort during daily transport.
Durable fabric: Material prepared to withstand frequent use.
Zip closure: Security and quick access to your belongings.
Official Real Madrid style: Shield and details adidas inspired by the white club.
